svg.desc: A plan drawn as a dependency graph in three waves. Wave 0 has two independent searches; one succeeds and one fails. Wave 1 has a read for each; the one depending on the failed search is blocked rather than failed. Wave 2, which needs both, is also blocked. The successful branch completed and its results are kept.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A plan is a graph, not a list

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Which is why failure has two different consequences.

svg.text: Two things a list cannot express:

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. The two searches are independent, so they run together. Three waves is the fastest this plan can be.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. One failure blocks exactly its descendants. The other branch finished, and its results are kept.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A failed task ran and broke. A blocked task never ran. Conflating them sends you

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: debugging a task that did nothing wrong - and replanning only needs to replace the ones that stuck.
